title: CAST: History-Adaptive Spectral Clipping for LLM Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2610.19761v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Soft spectral clipping (SSC) reduces gradient singular values, but its effect depends on the gradient scale and clipping threshold. We introduce CAST (Clipping with Adaptive Scales and Thresholds), a history-adaptive extension of SSC. AdamW's previous second moment sets row and column scales. An exponential moving average of the clipped output's estimated spectral norm sets each matrix's threshold. CAST restores the original coordinates before the AdamW update. We train a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model with 19.08B total parameters for 83.89B tokens. CAST achieves lower training and mean validation losses than nine gradient-processing baselines, with the fewest relative gradient spikes. It reaches the best baseline's final smoothed training loss in 7.2\% fewer steps.

translated_title: CAST：面向大语言模型预训练的历史自适应谱裁剪方法
translated_abstract: 软谱裁剪（SSC）能够降低梯度奇异值，但其效果取决于梯度尺度和裁剪阈值。我们提出了CAST（具有自适应尺度与阈值的裁剪），这是SSC的一种历史自适应扩展方法。CAST利用AdamW先前的二阶矩来设定行和列的尺度，并通过裁剪输出估计谱范数的指数移动平均来为每个矩阵设定阈值。此外，CAST会在AdamW更新之前恢复原始坐标。我们训练了一个总参数量为19.08B的混合专家（MoE）模型，共处理了83.89B个词元。CAST取得了比九个梯度处理基线更低的训练损失和平均验证损失，且相对梯度尖峰最少。它仅用少7.2%的步数就达到了最佳基线的最终平滑训练损失。
tldr: CAST通过利用AdamW二阶矩和谱范数指数移动平均等历史信息，自适应地设定谱裁剪的尺度与阈值，在19.08B参数MoE模型预训练中以更少步数实现了更低的损失和更少的梯度尖峰。
